h:
我创建了一个为 RPG Maker 生成侧视战斗精灵表的工作流程。由于仅使用 LoRA 很难一致地实现所需的布局（6 行 x 9 列），因此我利用 ControlNet 来确保输出严格遵循 RPG Maker 规范。

使用的自定义节点：

  • https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy

  • https://github.com/1038lab/ComfyUI-RMBG

使用的 ControlNet 模型：

  • https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Anima-LLLite/blob/main/model_patches/anima-lllite-any-test-like-v2.safetensors

o.en:
I've created a workflow for generating side-view battle sprite sheets for RPG Maker.Since it was difficult to consistently achieve the required layout (6 rows by 9 columns) using only LoRAs, I utilized ControlNet to ensure the output strictly follows the RPG Maker specifications.

Custom Nodes used:

  • https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy

  • https://github.com/1038lab/ComfyUI-RMBG

ControlNet Model used:

  • https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Anima-LLLite/blob/main/model_patches/anima-lllite-any-test-like-v2.safetensors
